dedupe_keys.name: nrwal wind cost and energy analysis library

description: NRWAL is a Python wind-analysis library maintained by US national laboratory researchers. It packages offshore-wind cost equations, configurable formulas and tools for applying them to geographic resource estimates, including integration with the Renewable Energy Potential model. Users supply wind-resource sites, technology and cost assumptions, and a chosen configuration; outputs are estimated energy and cost indicators across the selected locations. Geographic coverage can extend across continental study grids, but resolution follows the source resource data. BSD-3-Clause source, ready-to-use configurations and documentation are public. A limitation is that equations reflect technology and cost assumptions for a selected vintage; their results are screening estimates, not construction bids or turbine certification. NRWAL can support offshore wind siting and generation-cost scenarios. The catalogue's model-wtdigitwin-wind-turbine-digital-twin concerns an operating turbine, not regional project costs. No wind resource grid or package was downloaded.
